data.name: Emílio
data.long_meaning: From the Portuguese name 'Emílio', derived from the Latin name 'Aemilius'. This name has roots in the Roman clan name 'Aemilius'. It is composed of the elements 'aemulus', meaning 'rival' or 'emulator', and 'ilus', meaning 'little' or 'kind'. Thus, Emílio can be interpreted as 'rival little one' or 'emulator little one'.
